notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ حَمَّادُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ فَقَالَ لَهُ» names the asker, but the one asked (the pronoun «ه» and the answerer of «فَقَالَ») is not named in the text
by rule 5 the asker is not a link when the report is the answerer's; the answerer cannot be written without a name (rule 6), so no route is given and the case is held
